title: Guard early service refusal labels against drift from storage's later refusals
outcome: Guard early service refusal labels against drift from storage's later refusals
acceptance: A test drives each malformed input that the work service now refuses before navigation (validate_update_shape, handoff, completion links and acceptance, evaluation metadata, proposal drafts) through the storage request directly as well, and asserts the two refusal messages are identical; or the service and storage share one constant per label

completion.summary: Each label and refusal text that the early checks share with storage is one storage-owned constant in refusal_labels (18 labels, 5 messages, 1 formatter), substituted at every site with byte-identical texts. Landed as beab5b8.
